name: Duke Nukem 3D
author: stereomike, MrPeanut, Wally, Chilly Willy
description: PSP port of Duke Nukem 3D, based on the JonoF's Duke Nukem 3D port (JFDuke3D). The shareware version of the game is included. Credits for the port: stereomike: made the original PSP port; MrPeanut, Wally, Chilly Willy: worked further to improve it.
